title: The Real Cost of a Ford GT (And Why Owners Had to Sign a Contract)
description:
To buy a new Ford GT, money was not enough. You had to apply, wait to be chosen, and sign a contract promising not to sell the car for two years. One famous owner broke that promise, and Ford took him to court. Today we look at the real cost of a Ford GT, from the price on the contract to what it costs to keep one running, and why that contract existed at all. Here is the twist. The car that Ford sold for around half a million dollars was later valued much higher. So for most owners, the biggest cost of a Ford GT was not depreciation. It was everything else. Insurance, storage, tires, brakes, and the rules that came with it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
